From: Elena Torres <e.torres@harbor-analytics.com>

Cc: procurement@harbor-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase order and invoicing cadence for annual commit

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — Harbor is excited about the performance and the SKU-based pricing looks promising. We are working with AP to get a standard purchase order in place for the annual commitment (approx. $250,000 ARR). A couple of questions from procurement before we proceed: 

- Can Redwood accept a single blanket PO and then issue monthly invoices against that PO (Harbor prefers consolidated monthly invoices rather than milestone invoices)?
- Harbor requires Net45 on vendor invoices. Will Redwood accommodate Net45 for an enterprise commitment?
- For vendor onboarding, AP needs the specific PO fields populated (tax id, remit-to, PO number mapping to each invoice). I attached our PO template (Harbor_PO_template_v1.pdf).
- Is there an enterprise discount for an upfront annual commit or pre-pay? If so, can you summarize the discount levels?

We'd like to have the MSA + PO finalized within three weeks to hit our Q4 ramp. Happy to hop on a short call to walk AP through the invoice flow.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager
Harbor Analytics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchase order and invoicing cadence for annual commit

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear notes and the PO template. This is all doable in principle, want to surface a couple of constraints on our side so expectations are aligned: 

- Blanket PO + monthly invoices: We typically support a single master PO number and issue monthly consolidated invoices against it. We just need the PO number to appear on each invoice and a billing contact/email for AP.
- Net terms: Our default enterprise credit term is Net30. We can approve Net45 for renewals/commits with an approved credit application and finance sign-off. That requires Ben to run the terms with Finance.
- PO fields: please confirm Harbor's remit-to and tax ID fields; our billing team prefers the remit-to be the same as the address on the PO (we can accept EFT / wire instructions when we process).
- Discount: For a $250k ARR commitment we have standard tiered discounts; I will loop Marissa on pricing to confirm an exact % and any prepay incentives.

I've attached our invoice instructions for AP so they can map fields to our system. I'll coordinate with Marissa and Ben and get back with a concrete proposal by EOD tomorrow. If it's helpful, let's schedule a 30-minute call with Harbor AP and our billing team.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Purchase order and invoicing cadence for annual commit

Looping finance/legal for visibility. Quick notes from Sales Ops: 

- PO + monthly invoices: OK from a payments processing perspective. We need: billing_email, PO number on each invoice, and a single remit-to address. We can absorb monthly invoicing overhead but prefer invoices to be consolidated (one line per month with usage/sku breakdown).
- Net45: Finance can make exceptions for strategic deals with a credit application and a signed MSA. Ben — can you confirm whether Net45 is approvable for HLR-2026-082 pending credit review?
- Discounts: For $250k ARR, we typically start approvals at 10% list; with prepay or 12-month term we can escalate to 15% subject to CRO/pricing committee sign-off. Any add-on seat or usage tiers should be called out in the SOW.
- Billing support: We should include a short billing appendix in the SOW that enumerates invoice cadence, PO mapping, VAT/us tax treatment, and a contact for remittance exceptions. 

Monica — please flag any legal requirements around PO wording (insurance, indemnity) that would block acceptance of Harbor's template as-is. I attached our enterprise terms summary for reference.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — helpful. A few clarifications from Harbor AP: 

- Harbor will provide a blanket PO number and prefers three consolidated monthly invoices (one per month for the first three months) as we will be ramping usage and want smaller monthly amounts for internal approvals. Can Redwood issue three sequential monthly invoices under the single PO?
- Net45 is a hard requirement for our vendor policy. We will complete any credit paperwork but need confirmation Redwood can commit to Net45 before legal & procurement will sign.
- Discount: Harbor is requesting a written discount commitment (percentage and whether it applies to overage usage). A 15% endorsed discount on committed spend would make this an easy approval for Harbor; please confirm if that is possible.

Proposed timeline: MSA + SOW signed and PO in place by 08/28 so we can start the onboarding POC in September.

Elena
Elena Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager, Harbor Analytics
procurement@harbor-analytics.com
